notes.title: Survivor Jones Demo (3 level loop)
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ks-5noI0W10;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]You find yourself flying over a previously undiscovered island in the middle of the Bermuda Triangle. Suddenly your plane is struck by lightning!

Play as [b]Jennifer Jones[/b] or [b]Junior Jones[/b]. Rescue your sibling and find a way off the island!

This game is heavily inspired by 1981 Frogger. Leap for your life, collect coins, fight bosses, collect magical cards and die in terrible ways only to try again.

Survivor Jones is currently being sold as a playable pre-alpha and will continue to be a work in progress until all 4 chapters of the game have been released. 

All further updates of the game will be included in the original purchase price. Enjoy the free demo - all feedback is welcome!

[b]Update from 23-Aug (version 0.0.2):[/b]

- Added achievement screen (online leaderboard coming soon)
- Fixed reported fps issues when ogres hit trees
- Desert sand levels (3 levels completed, now included in full game)

[b]Update from 22-Aug (version 0.0.1):[/b]

- Softened fire light
- Fixed bug in the Demo not looping correctly
- Desert sand levels (work in progress)

notes.title: Update (5): Character acceleration, Spirit consuming skull
notes.content:
Major changes:

- Added player acceleration (PC/ PS4)
(This helps to provide more precision control at slower speeds)
- Added life consuming skull underground
(Rewards player with gold for every 3 souls consumed by the skull)


Minor changes:

- Improved base layer tiles for walls
- Splash screen animation speed fix
- New underground audio fix
- Added tiki torches to underground levels for atmosphere
